verdict.rationale: Exa is API-first. Search, contents, answer, deep research/Agent, Connect and Websets (including enrichment and webhooks) are all documented as API capabilities. The docs present the Websets Dashboard as a no-code alternative to the API, and the UI's 'Get Code' export suggests UI actions map to API calls. Missing for 10: an explicit UI/API parity statement, evidence that account, team and API-key administration is available via API beyond the Stripe Projects signup command, a published OpenAPI spec (probes 404), and independent corroboration (one user reported the 'Get Code' cURL example was wrong).
